name: CRM Table
summary: A sortable table of sales deals with stage pills, per-stage filter chips showing totals, and a live count and sum of the visible rows.
useWhen: Showing a sales pipeline as rows, sorted by amount or close date
Filtering deals by stage and seeing the sum change
avoidWhen: The board view matters more than rows; a pipeline component in business fits better
Large datasets need paging or column controls; use a full data table instead
